about: Shared cases for the relationships view as Mermaid when a graph has written groups (clusters, editor spec §31; wiki/Mermaid-mapping-review.md, gap G1). A group draws as a subgraph and its members sit inside. Both libraries must write each expected text, byte for byte.

cases.name: a group draws as a subgraph
cases.expected:
flowchart LR
    n2["c"]
    subgraph g3["team"]
        n0["a"]
        n1["b"]
    end
    n0 -->|knows| n2

cases.name: a group inside a group nests
cases.expected:
flowchart LR
    subgraph g1["outer"]
        subgraph g0["inner"]
            n2["x"]
        end
        n3["y"]
    end

cases.name: a second membership stays a link and an empty group stays a box
cases.expected:
flowchart LR
    n1["empty"]
    subgraph g2["p"]
        n0["a"]
    end
    n3["q"]
    n0 -->|member of| n3

cases.name: groups that hold each other break the loop
cases.expected:
flowchart LR
    subgraph g0["c1"]
        n1["c2"]
        n2["x"]
    end
    g0 -->|member of| n1

cases.name: a graph with no groups is written as before
cases.expected:
flowchart LR
    n0["a"]
    n1["b"]
    n0 -->|knows| n1
